messages.subject: error in unite with min.per.group
parts:
I am trying to run the 'unite' function, specifying min.per.group=3L (there are 5 samples within each group), but am receiving the following error message:
Error in data.frame(chr = locs[, 1], start = as.numeric(locs[, 2]), end = as.numeric(locs[,  :
  (list) object cannot be coerced to type 'double'
When I run 'unite' without specifying 'min.per.group', there is no error message. Any idea what the problem might be?
Thanks.
